ModMetaData.name: Ra2Bunker Endpoint LOS Fix V3
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: Mono-safe RimWorld 1.5.4063 LOS patch for Ra2Bunker. The bunker blocks outside-to-outside sight and fire like a wall, while bunker occupants can still fire outward and outside attackers can target the bunker itself. No Ra2Bunker gameplay classes are replaced.
